ERROR Npgsql.NpgsqlOperationInProgressException: A command is already in progress: SELECT C.NAME AS CATEGORY, P.SKU, P.NAME AS PRODUCT, SUM(L.QUANTITY) AS UNITS, SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) AS SALES FROM ORDER_LINES L JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_ID = L.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = L.PRODUCT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', O.ORDER_DATE) AS INTEGER) = :SALES_YEAR GROUP BY C.NAME, P.SKU, P.NAME ORDER BY C.NAME, SALES DESC
